title: Governed redispatch after WORK_ITEM_UNBLOCKED — READY + canonically-terminal bound predecessor becomes eligible for ONE new mission attempt
description: Root cause: a work item unblocked to READY after a canonically terminal bound mission could never be redispatched autonomously — adaptive review classified READY+terminal-bound as INTERVENTION and the operating loop's launchable filter required no bound mission, while manual openWorkItem worked (it already re-proves every prior attempt terminal). Fix adds lifecycle class REOPENABLE: READY + bound latest mission canonically terminal + EVERY WOB attempt proven terminal via assertCanonicalMissionLifecycle + READY itself derived from the canonical WORK_ITEM_UNBLOCKED event (PAUSED/live/missing/unproven predecessor keeps INTERVENTION; live+READY contradiction still reviewFails). Operating loop: launchable admits REOPENABLE alongside fresh ACTIVE allocations; proveDispatchAuthority's bound-mission branch now re-proves the claim canonically — terminal claim must carry full lifecycle evidence (forged status fails before any write), then falls through to BusinessLayer.openWorkItem which remains the ONLY open authority and itself iterates every prior attempt (non-terminal => FAIL_CLOSED_MISSION_ACTIVE); PAUSED/non-terminal still converges via assertCanonicalMissionInFlight => AWAITING_EXECUTION. Immutable WOB history/mission evidence untouched; concurrent ticks/restart dedup via existing pending-open + bound-mission convergence; review never auto-ACCEPTed, intervention semantics preserved for genuinely stuck states; Hotfix A seams untouched (F6 consume-time re-proof exercised by reopened attempt). 8 canonical-fixture tests: eligible reopen, forged READY, forged lifecycle (status-only FAILED claim), tampered WOB, concurrent tick + store-reopen restart (exactly one attempt), mission-cap hard stop, revoked auto-policy, A+B cross-mission artifact consume through pinned LOCAL_MATERIALIZATION. 104+58 regression pass; baseline pair-f4 R5.1-crash identical on BASE.
